sentences.en: People once mocked the idea that the earth is round.
sentences.zh: 人们曾经嘲笑地球是圆的这个想法。

sentences.en: When Dan complained about the loud music, Linda mocked him.
sentences.zh: 丹抱怨音乐太大声时，琳达取笑他。

sentences.en: Every nation mocks at other nations, and all are right.
sentences.zh: 每个国家都在嘲弄其他国家，而它们都有理由这么做。
